desc: Derive fixed-T cost model: cost = Σ|cnt_i − fin_i| − Σ x_i with greedy maximal adjacent carries; prove chains/over-carries (distance ≥ 2) are never better than delete+insert (WLOG), that maximal adjacent carry is optimal, and that an optimal T ≤ maxcnt exists — reduces fixed-T subproblem to an O(26) 2-state chain DP.

Implement makeStringGood with the O(26·maxcnt) solution: freq count; for each target T in 1..maxcnt run 2-state chain DP (fin_i ∈ {0,T}) with greedy adjacent carry x = min(surplus_i, deficit_{i+1}); track global min; respect z boundary (no carry out of index 25).

Build an independent brute-force validator (Dijkstra over count vectors with delete/insert/change moves, alphabet ≤ 4 letters, n ≤ 8, counting only good final states) and cross-check the DP on randomized small cases, targeting carry chains, ties (cnt = T/2, distance-2 changes), and zero-count letters.

Verify provided examples 1–3 and add edge/performance tests: all identical characters, all 'z', strictly increasing/decreasing counts, many zero frequencies, insert-only/delete-only scenarios, and timing on random n = 2·10^4 strings.
